title: Push payload
description: The Clomni keys of a push: an FCM data message (no notification block, high priority; every value arrives as a string there, unread_total included), or the keys next to aps on APNs (aps.alert {title, body}, sound default, badge = unread_total, mutable-content 1). Sent only when the user has no open socket, grouped over 10 seconds: one push per user and conversation, with the last message.
